parameters.content:
## Mock AI conversation — development only
POST /webhook/restaurant-dev/ai-conversation
Uses the existing Header Auth token and a separate Groq Bearer Auth credential.
Groq returns a constrained intent and SKU list; the workflow validates it and computes mock prices locally.
No cart persistence, order creation, payment, or WhatsApp delivery. Keep workflow 01 unchanged.
